headline: European Natural Gas Prices Reach $110 per MWh Amid Supply Disruptions
summary: European natural gas futures climbed to nearly 100 euros ($110.54) per megawatt-hour on Monday, reaching their highest level since 2022 amid ongoing Middle East conflicts.
why: European gas benchmarks determine electricity generation costs and industrial input prices across the European Union.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Escalating geopolitical conflicts disrupted Middle Eastern energy supply routes, tightening spot supply.

why_moved: Supply security concerns driven by Middle East hostilities spurred aggressive bidding on European gas benchmarks.
